findings.title: Prometheus-only rows break existing rule actions
findings.body: This supplies only `promRule`, so the menu receives no `rulerRule`. The menu still requires a ruler rule to render Pause and Delete, making both actions disappear from the new Grafana list. It can also show Silence based on the Prometheus rule, but the drawer is only mounted when a ruler alert rule exists, so clicking Silence does nothing. Adapt these actions to work with the Prometheus DTO or avoid exposing a nonfunctional action.

findings.title: Rule view links no longer preserve the originating list URL
findings.body: The previous Grafana rule loader added a `returnTo` URL to this view link. Omitting it means opening a rule from a filtered or otherwise customized rule list loses that originating context when the user returns from the rule view. Preserve the current return URL as before.

findings.title: Federated rules are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: The previous `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` checked `rule.group` for `source_tenants` and disabled editing and deletion for federated rules. This refactor drops the group information and hardcodes `isFederated` to false, so callers of the combined-rule ability hook now expose Update, Delete, and related actions for federated rules that were intentionally blocked. Preserve the federated-group check when delegating to the new hook.
